name: Williden's Journal
label: Quest
description: Williden's Journal: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have uncovered a mangled journal. Parts of it remain legible, with a Williden Marshal claiming ownership over the contents therein. If the journal is accurate, then Williden may be found somewhere in the northern part of the Crater; according to the journal, he and his companions sought higher ground from the savage beasts of the Crater once their base camps were overrun.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello there! I and my companions are happy to see some living beings here other than overgrown savage beasts! What brings you into the Un'Goro Crater?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well look at this - my journal! I thought it was lost, much like almost everything else we brought into Un'Goro. I thank you kindly for returning this to me!
